entries.title: Angled above, Ordering
changes: Robots with several fixed shooters fire from all of them: the robot turns the shooter chosen to aim it (or else the first) to the target, and the rest fire along with it.
Fuel drawn at its true size
Robots slide along walls instead of sticking

entries.title: Name Colors, Turreted dumper, more Tags
changes: Custom Skins are legal in all Multiplayer Matches
Some robots can't pass back to Alliance Zone
New robot tags: Open top, No passing, Limited turret, Turreted dumper and Double turret.

entries.title: Leaderboards
changes: Game Seasons for drive pass and leaderboards
Vanity Structures more angles of freedom

entries.title: Drive Pass and LED strips
changes:
Drive Pass
its like battle pass but for robotics
Energized now needs 630 fuel and Supercharged 1000; Traversal stays at 50 tower points.

entries.title: Full Multiplayer Update
changes: Robots can be chosen within rooms
Many more stuff i dont remmebe

entries.title: Truer shooting, and settings in your account
changes: Shooters that adjust for distance now drop fuel into the middle of the hub instead of slightly long.
The launch angle is the steepest a shooter can use; for long shots it flattens as far as it needs to.
Signed in, your chosen robot and all your settings, controls included, follow you to any device.

entries.title: Player records
changes: Individual Player screens and other stuff i think

entries.title: Beta Multiplayer
changes: Room Code and Hostable Private Rooms
Host Runs the whole match on their device
Account System (Might remove if this is too laggy)

entries.title: More Shooter Calibration
changes: Different fire rates in Auto, accounting for robot leaning
Tower frames are in the alliance color, with bear metal (2046) rungs.

entries.title: Controls and DIsplay
changes: Outtake, Expand Hopper, Climb, and shot Blocker

entries.title: Official score display
changes: Rebuilt (Presented by Haas) official score display
Fuel that leaves the field is thrown back in.
Reset now resets the whole field.

entries.title: Passing and hub lights
changes: Hoppers show how full they are

entries.title: Robot builder
changes: Each Subsystem is a customizable assembly
Bumpers and drive train canbe reshaped

entries.title: FRC 2026 Rebuilt (Presented by Haas)
changes: Driving sandbox with swerve and tank drives, physics testing and other stuff
